overview.subtitle: Here is how {company} is doing on the marketplace today.
overview.welcomeBody: Your supplier account is ready. Publish your first product and complete your factory profile — verified buyers are already posting RFQs in your category.

checklist.title: Get your profile ready for buyers
checklist.description: Suppliers with a complete profile receive up to three times more RFQ invitations.
checklist.profileHint: Description, phone number and city are what buyers check first.
checklist.factoryHint: Address, production lines and capacity — buyers filter on these.
checklist.productHint: Products drive search visibility and RFQ matching.
checklist.kybHint: Verified suppliers get the badge buyers look for and Trade Assurance orders.
checklist.kybPending: Your KYB file is under review.

overview.recentRfqsHint: Public RFQs in your categories plus direct invitations.
overview.noRfqsHint: Publish products in more categories to get matched with more buyer requests.

products.title: Products
products.description: Your catalogue on the marketplace — drafts, listings in review and live products.
products.noResultsHint: Nothing found for “{q}”. Try another word or clear the search.
products.emptyDescription: Add your first product — a title, a category, a price and one photo are enough to start.
products.deleteDescription: It disappears from your catalogue and the marketplace. Orders that reference it keep their history.
products.newDescription: Save as a draft first — you can publish once the listing has a photo and a price.
products.savedDraft: Draft saved. Add photos and a price, then publish when you are ready.
products.savedActive: Your product is live on the marketplace.
products.savedPending: Your product was submitted and will be reviewed by our team shortly.

productForm.rejectedBody: Fix the points raised by the reviewer and submit it again.
productForm.basicsHint: The title and description are what buyers search on — be specific about material, size and use.
productForm.title: Product title
productForm.titlePlaceholder: e.g. 35L recycled polyester hiking backpack with rain cover
productForm.shortDescriptionHint: One sentence shown in search results.
productForm.descriptionHint: Materials, construction, sizes, printing options, packaging — at least 20 characters to publish.
productForm.keywordsHint: Comma separated, up to 30. Used for search matching.
productForm.pricingHint: Tiered prices per quantity band get the most buyer engagement.
productForm.noTiers: No tiers yet — add quantity bands with a unit price for each.
productForm.customizableHint: Colour, size, logo or material can be changed.
productForm.hasSampleHint: Buyers can order a sample before the bulk order.
productForm.packagingPlaceholder: Polybag + hangtag per unit, 20 units per export carton, carton 60 × 40 × 40 cm
productForm.shippingPlaceholder: FOB Cat Lai / Hai Phong, 1×40HQ ≈ 9,000 pcs
productForm.variantsHint: Colours, sizes or configurations of the same product.
productForm.noVariants: No variants — the product is sold in one configuration.
productForm.specificationsHint: Technical data shown as a table on the product page.
productForm.certificationsHint: Tick the standards this product complies with.

images.title: Images
images.hint: Up to 8 photos. The first one is the cover image shown in search results.
images.none: No images yet. At least one photo is required to publish.
images.uploadHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each.

productForm.pendingNote: In review — changes are saved but the listing stays hidden until approved.

company.title: Company profile
company.description: How buyers see your company on the marketplace and in RFQ matching.
company.identityHint: Shown on your public profile, product pages and quotations.
company.logoHint: Square PNG or JPG, at least 200 × 200 px.
company.coverHint: Wide photo of your factory or products, at least 1200 × 500 px.
company.name: Company name
company.taglinePlaceholder: e.g. OEM backpacks and technical bags for outdoor brands
company.aboutHint: Products, markets, certifications, what makes your factory different.
company.aboutPlaceholder: What you make, who you make it for, and how you work with buyers…
company.industriesHint: Pick every industry you serve; the primary one drives RFQ matching.
company.capabilitiesHint: Used by buyers to filter suppliers and by CANG to match you with RFQs.

factory.title: Factory profile
factory.description: Production capacity, equipment and photos — the details serious buyers audit before they order.
factory.mainEquipmentHint: Machines, lines and tooling buyers ask about.
factory.mainMaterialsHint: Fabrics, metals, components and the suppliers you source them from.
factory.mediaHint: Photos go live on your public profile straight away.
factory.videoUrlsHint: One YouTube or Vimeo URL per line.
factory.addPhotosHint: Production hall, lines, QC, warehouse — JPG or PNG up to 10 MB.
factory.photosHint: {count, plural, =0 {No photos published} =1 {1 photo published} other {# photos published}}
factory.noPhotos: No factory photos yet. Add some above — profiles with photos get more RFQ invitations.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Standards and audits your company holds. Verified certificates show as badges on your profile.
certifications.reviewNote: Upload the certificate itself where you can — our team verifies each one and it then shows as verified on your public profile.
certifications.addDescription: Choose the standard and attach the certificate for verification.
certifications.documentHint: PDF or image, visible to our verification team only.
certifications.emptyHint: Add ISO, BSCI, OEKO-TEX and other standards your factory holds.

team.title: Team
team.description: Invite colleagues and control what they can do on behalf of your company.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Everything that happened on your RFQs, quotations, orders and payments.
notifications.emptyHint: We will let you know as soon as a buyer posts a matching RFQ or an order moves.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your personal account details and password.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Every file attached to your products, quotations, orders and compliance file.
documents.emptyHint: Files you attach to quotations, orders and your verification are collected here.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: How buyers find and engage with your company over the last 30 days.
analytics.emptyHint: Metrics appear once your products are live and buyers start viewing them.

charts.leadsHint: Inquiries from product pages plus RFQs matched to you.
charts.gmvHint: Gross value of orders placed, in USD.

funnel.title: RFQ funnel
funnel.hint: From RFQ match to won order.
funnel.note: All time. Quote faster and follow up in messages to lift the conversion.

advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.description: Featured placements and search boosts to put your products in front of more buyers.
advertising.createDescription: Campaigns start after our team reviews them, usually within one business day.
advertising.name: Campaign name
advertising.namePlaceholder: e.g. Spring backpack launch — featured products
advertising.productHint: Optional for supplier and search placements.
advertising.keywordsHint: Comma separated search terms for search placements.
advertising.emptyHint: Feature a product or boost your search ranking to get more inquiries.
advertising.placementsHint: Pricing per ad product; the review team activates campaigns within one business day.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.description: Your plan, its limits and the upgrades available to your company.
subscription.pendingBody: Requested on {date} with {cycle} billing. Our team confirms the upgrade and sends the invoice — nothing is charged automatically.
subscription.noPlan: No plan found for your company.
subscription.askOwner: Ask an account owner to change the plan.
subscription.noPayment: Plan changes are confirmed by the CANG team. You will receive an invoice by email; no card is charged on this page.
subscription.requestDescription: We will confirm the change and send an invoice. The new limits apply once it is paid.

api.title: API access
api.description: Keys for integrating your ERP or PIM with CANG — sync products, receive RFQs and read orders.
api.planTitle: API access is not included in your plan
api.planBody: You can create keys for testing, but requests are rate-limited until you upgrade to a plan with API access.
api.createdBody: Copy it now — for security we only store a hash and cannot show it again.
api.createDescription: Give it a name you will recognise and only the scopes the integration needs.
api.name: Key name
api.emptyHint: Create a key to connect your systems. Each key can be revoked at any time.
api.docsHint: Send the key as a bearer token on every request.
api.docsAuth: All endpoints live under /api/v1 and accept and return JSON. Keys are scoped to your company.
api.docsScopes: A request outside the key's scopes returns 403. Revoke a key immediately if it leaks — a new one is created in seconds.
